caso.texto:
A fictional service proposal costs 12,000 currency units for diagnosis and a plan, excluding implementation. The buyer offers 9,000 with implementation in ten days. The closer may request review but cannot approve discounts. Required inputs arrive in two weeks.

An Indian services buyer compares INR 300,000 for diagnosis with INR 225,000 for a narrower review. Accounts must confirm invoice and tax treatment; operational inputs are delayed. A lower price cannot fix unavailable data.

projeto.instrucoes: Run three negotiation rounds, propose two options for authorised review and produce a pending-conditions summary and delivery handoff.
projeto.gabarito: Do not accept lower price with broader scope and timing preceding inputs. Explore the underlying interest. Options: retain diagnosis with feasible timing or seek approval for narrower scope. Promise no concession; preserve exclusions, dependencies and accepted version.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
